import csv, hashlib, io, json, re
from pathlib import Path

source = Path('products/services/canadabuys-data-qa-intake/raw/new-tender-notices.csv')
output = source.parent.parent / 'new-notice-description-screen.json'
raw = source.read_bytes()
reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'), newline=''))
fields = reader.fieldnames or []
descriptions = [name for name in fields if 'description' in name.casefold()]
metadata = [name for name in fields if re.search(r'title|reference|solicitation|clos|notice.*url|url.*notice', name, re.I)]
patterns = {
    'reconciliation': re.compile(r'\b(?:reconcil\w*|rapprochement|réconciliation)\b', re.I),
    'data_quality': re.compile(r'\b(?:data quality|qualité des données|data cleansing|nettoyage des données|data validation|validation des données|data deduplication|dédoublonnage)\b', re.I),
    'catalogue_inventory': re.compile(r'\b(?:catalog\w*|inventor\w*|inventaire)\b.{0,65}\b(?:reconcil\w*|verif\w*|vérifi\w*|valid\w*|audit\w*|rapprochement|migration)\b', re.I),
    'spreadsheet': re.compile(r'\b(?:spreadsheet|tableur|fichier CSV|CSV file|Excel workbook)\b', re.I),
}
hits = []
count = 0
for count, row in enumerate(reader, 1):
    matches = []
    for field in descriptions:
        text = ' '.join((row.get(field) or '').split())
        for label, pattern in patterns.items():
            match = pattern.search(text)
            if match:
                matches.append({'field': field, 'signal': label, 'normalized_excerpt': text[max(0, match.start()-90):match.end()+90]})
    if matches:
        hits.append({'feed_record': count, 'navigation': {name: row.get(name) for name in metadata}, 'matches': matches})
result = {'source': 'https://canadabuys.canada.ca/opendata/pub/newTenderNotice-nouvelAvisAppelOffres.csv', 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'records': count, 'description_fields': descriptions, 'headers': fields, 'candidate_count': len(hits), 'candidates': hits, 'scope': 'Keyword navigation in the saved new-notice snapshot. The original notice governs dates, scope, eligibility and response. A keyword hit alone does not establish a fit. A missing description column means the screen had no description coverage.'}
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({key: result[key] for key in ('source_sha256', 'records', 'description_fields', 'candidate_count')}, ensure_ascii=False))
